task_description: Create a dedicated Supabase coworking_spaces table with pricing fields, seed it from existing spaces data, connect CoworkingSpaces and CoworkingDetail pages to read from it, and add admin panel CRUD pages for managing coworking listings.

verification.summary: Build passes with 398 static pages. All new code (schema SQL, seed script, useCoworkingSpaces hook, admin pages, component modifications) builds cleanly. The coworking_spaces table needs to be created via the Supabase Dashboard SQL Editor (DDL cannot be executed via REST API) - the application gracefully falls back to existing data when the table is absent.

notes: Table creation: Run supabase/coworking_spaces_schema.sql in Supabase Dashboard SQL Editor at https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/oijtkvkyefqfwuycibcv/sql. Then run: node scripts/seed-coworking.mjs to populate data.
